Madras HC: Converts to Islam lose Backward Class status

The Madras High Court has ruled that individuals converting to Islam cannot claim Backward Class Muslim status. The court stated that a person converting to Islam becomes "just a Muslim" and does not retain their original caste identity for reservation purposes. This decision impacts the eligibility for certain affirmative action benefits.
